scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite exact-arithmetic checks. Published facet theorem and prior metric formula are credited; no formal certification or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to positive integer parameters with the first parameter at least two and to Euclidean balls in the original coordinate realization.
Uses the published parking-function facet theorem and a previously established scalar inradius formula; only the attainable simultaneous-contact patterns and maximum contact count are claimed as new.
The exact infinite-dimensional-parameter statement rests on the supplied proof, not on its finite computational tests.
Equivalent statements under another name may exist; no independent validation has been performed.
title: Perfect-square resonance classifies simultaneous inball contacts of integral parking-function polytopes
